digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration for rebar review gates
propositions: Local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles instead of direct Anthropic models, using existing AWS CLI credentials and the layered config file approach.

All local gate runs (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) against Bedrock must return parseable verdicts with structured output validation, demonstrating functional parity with the Anthropic baseline.
Prompt caching must engage and be observable on the Bedrock path, with nonzero cache_read_tokens recorded in the usage log across multiple calls, not merely cache writes.
Every invocation in a measured run must resolve exclusively to Bedrock inference profiles with zero calls to direct Anthropic, verified through the provider-clean check in REBAR_USAGE_LOG.
The absence of a TTL field in Bedrock's cachePoint versus Anthropic's cache_control must be evaluated and stated with evidence, clarifying whether it causes observable behavioral or cost differences.
Developer opt-in and revert procedures must be documented in docs/local-dev-env.md and the revert must be executed once to confirm a single-step return to Anthropic is possible.
